title: The Follower
tagline: No physics engine. Each bead only chases the one in front.
idea: An input-and-output field sends an event whenever it changes, so a moving object can drive other nodes. A PositionDamper chases a place smoothly (tau is how lazy it is). Chain dampers and the lag adds up into a tail that looks alive.

challenges.title: Grow the tail
challenges.ask: Beads 3 and 4 sit on the floor. Make them follow.
challenges.hint: Add a PositionDamper. Seg2's translation goes to its set_destination; its value_changed goes to Seg3's translation. Repeat for Seg4. Try a bigger tau on the last one.

challenges.title: Take the wheel
challenges.ask: Drag the golden head with the mouse.
challenges.hint: Add a PlaneSensor that sits in Rig. Wire its translation_changed to Head's translation, and cut the wire from Path so the two do not fight. Then drag the head.

challenges.title: A light that knows it is moving
challenges.ask: Make the green beacon appear only while the tail is still catching up.
challenges.hint: A damper sends isActive: yes while it is still moving, no when it has arrived. Wire the last damper's isActive to Beacon's visible.

script:
def snake():
    b = bg.Behaviour()
    clock = b.add("TimeSensor", "Clock", loop=True, cycleInterval=7)
    path = b.add("PositionInterpolator", "Path",
                 key=[0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875, 1],
                 keyValue=[(0, 2.2, 0), (2.2, 3.4, 0), (3.6, 2.2, 0), (2.2, 1, 0), (0, 2.2, 0),
                           (-2.2, 3.4, 0), (-3.6, 2.2, 0), (-2.2, 1, 0), (0, 2.2, 0)])
    head = b.target("Transform", "Head")
    seg1 = b.target("Transform", "Seg1")
    seg2 = b.target("Transform", "Seg2")
    follow1 = b.add("PositionDamper", "Follow1", tau=0.25, order=2, initialValue=(-1, 0.5, 0), initialDestination=(-1, 0.5, 0))
    follow2 = b.add("PositionDamper", "Follow2", tau=0.25, order=2, initialValue=(-2, 0.5, 0), initialDestination=(-2, 0.5, 0))
    clock.fraction_changed >> path.set_fraction
    path.value_changed >> head.translation
    head.translation >> follow1.set_destination     # a Transform also SENDS its translation whenever it changes
    follow1.value_changed >> seg1.translation       # the damper chases that place, smoothly, and moves segment 1
    seg1.translation >> follow2.set_destination     # segment 2 chases segment 1: a chain
    follow2.value_changed >> seg2.translation
    return b
